fork_rule: first scheduled evaluation with full train accuracy >= 0.99; test and validation data are not consulted
intervention: theta* = theta_t + radial(Delta) + c * tangential(Delta), Delta = actual AdamW update; theta_{t+1} = R_{t+1} * theta* / ||theta*||, R_{t+1} = reference norm after the same step
parameter_vector: all weights and biases, order w1 w2 w3 b1 b2 b3
adamw_state: copied from the fork into every slice, then updated normally from each slice's own gradients
minibatches: one shared stream for all slices; EpochSampler seed 2010000
loss: nn.MSELoss mean over batch and 10 outputs, one-hot targets
evaluation_schedule: steps after fork: 0-99 every step, 100-990 every 10, then every 100
